subject.title: fix(agents): carry provenance through active subagent wakes

question: Should active subagent wake provenance be carried through an internal queue/transcript metadata path, or become a public `AgentSession.steer()` plugin SDK option?
rationale: The PR fixes a real provenance gap but changes public API shape, and current main now has a different queued-turn metadata owner path that automation should not override without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep provenance internal
options.body: Rework the PR onto current main so subagent wake provenance travels through internal queue/transcript metadata without increasing plugin SDK public exports.

options.title: Approve public steer options
options.body: Accept the new `AgentSession.steer()` options object as plugin API, then add maintainer-visible docs and compatibility coverage before merge.

options.title: Pause for broader provenance design
options.body: Hold this PR until the related subagent/session provenance issues settle into one canonical API boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep provenance internal
recommendation.body: Rework the PR onto current main so subagent wake provenance travels through internal queue/transcript metadata without increasing plugin SDK public exports.

likelyOwner.reason: Pick-cat authored the current queued user-turn transcript metadata path that this PR now needs to integrate with.
